goal: Generate a 1:1 overall image containing 16 independently cuttable Q-moe character stickers, for use as album thumbnails or image splitting on WeChat chat panels.
theme: Daily life of urban workers (commuting, meetings, slacking off, overtime, eating, lying flat, striving, complaining).

style.rendering: 3D Q cute + soft light + matte material, non-realistic
style.color_palette: Milk tea beige + ink gray + mint green accents, avoiding highly stimulating neon.

sticker_design.shadow: Each piece has a soft shadow with 8% transparency in an oval shape below
sticker_design.label_style: Bold round handwritten black text placed in the gap below the character, no English

layout.background: Light oat color, no texture or extremely faint noise.
layout.spacing: Cell spacing is uniformly about 3% of the side length

items: A little person pulling the hanging ring in the subway + '8 AM'
Lying at the workstation with coffee for a boost + 'revival'
Pretending to take notes in the conference room + 'received'.
Late-night desk lamp tapping on the keyboard + 'overtime'
called out by the boss to stand at attention + 'stunned'
Countdown calendar for holidays + 'Looking forward to the holiday'
Forgot umbrella on a rainy day + 'disheveled'
Turn off the lights and clock out + 'I'm out'

must_keep: Each piece is independent and not sticky, with a unified style
Chinese labels have no typographical errors, font sizes are consistent.
avoid: Include WeChat green logo or Tencent trademark
